documents_binding_not_found: The binding {binding} does not exist in the instance {instance}.
documents_binding_not_found_fix: Available bindings: {available}. --file takes the binding id, not a path.
documents_binding_refused: The binding {binding} of the instance {instance} was refused: {reason}
documents_binding_is_directory: The binding {binding} is a directory; choose one of its files.
documents_binding_is_directory_fix: Pass --entry with one of these files: {available}
documents_entry_not_found: The file {entry} is not among the files of the binding {binding}.
documents_entry_not_allowed: The binding {binding} is a file; --entry only applies to a directory binding.
documents_missing_fix: Create the file with jgates tools config write --if-match absent, or point the binding to an existing file.
documents_not_text: The file {path} cannot be edited as text ({reason}).
documents_not_a_file: The path {path} is not a regular file.
documents_read_only_fix_local: Edit the right source or adjust the file permission; with access: read in tools.yml JGates only reads the file.
documents_read_only_fix_governed: Governed files are not written by the editor; create an override allowed by the policy.
documents_read_only_fix_package: Files of the installed package are not written; create a local copy and point the binding to it.
documents_encoding: The text does not fit the {encoding} encoding of {path}: {detail}
documents_encoding_fix: Remove the characters {encoding} cannot represent; the file is never silently converted to another encoding.
documents_invalid: The new text of {path} has a syntax error; nothing was written.
documents_invalid_fix: Fix the error, or write anyway explicitly (--allow-invalid), knowing that the plan that depends on it stays blocked.
documents_path_changed: The path of {path} changed between the check and the write (symbolic link or swapped folder); nothing was written.
documents_path_changed_fix: Check the file and the links on the path, read again and repeat.
documents_write_failed: Writing {path} failed and the file stayed as it was: {detail}
documents_write_failed_fix: Check the disk space and the permissions and repeat.
documents_verify_failed: The check after writing {path} did not match the content sent.
documents_verify_failed_fix: Read the file again and check; another process may have written at the same time.
documents_validation_unavailable: Syntax validation is unavailable for the format {format}.
documents_reason_FS_READ_ONLY: the file or its folder has no write permission
documents_reason_TOO_LARGE: file too large for the editor ({size} bytes)
documents_reason_NAME_NOT_ALLOWED: file name not allowed on this platform ({detail})
documents_reason_PARENT_MISSING: the folder of the file does not exist
documents_exists_fix: Choose another name: renaming never overwrites a file.
documents_new_entry_refused: The file {entry} cannot be created in this binding ({reason}).
documents_new_entry_refused_fix: Create files only inside the binding folder, with a relative path that matches include, and with write access.
